**Serbia: how applications changed.** The extract records 803,731 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 109,891 in 2015, compared with 8,082 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 32% lower than in 2019 (11,888). Applications in 2025 were 38% lower than in 2024 (12,975). In 2025, the leading destinations were France (3,609; 45%), Germany (2,935; 36%), Belgium (427; 5.3%). France received 45% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 48% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 6.8%, across 6,837 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 24% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 1.3 percentage points higher than in 2024 (5.4%).
